# `video` — `/api/video`

Video router — Wan2.1 text-to-video jobs, the video library, edit jobs (trim and join clips, transitions, audio tracks), captions with Whisper, and Creative Commons background music from Jamendo.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/video/captions/jobs`](#post-api-video-captions-jobs) | Transcribe an uploaded/exported clip with Whisper and either return the .srt (result_text) or a captioned mp4 with the subtitles burned in (result_path), depending on `burn_in`. |
| POST | [`/api/video/edit/jobs`](#post-api-video-edit-jobs) | Trim and concatenate an ordered list of clips (each either a library job's output or a freshly uploaded file) into one video. |
| GET | [`/api/video/library`](#get-api-video-library) | Completed video-generation jobs, newest first. |
| GET | [`/api/video/music/proxy`](#get-api-video-music-proxy) | Stream a Jamendo track's audio through our backend (sidesteps any client-side CORS/mixed-content issues). |
| GET | [`/api/video/music/search`](#get-api-video-music-search) | Search Jamendo's Creative Commons catalog for background music. |
| POST | [`/api/video/wan2/jobs`](#post-api-video-wan2-jobs) | Start a Wan2.1 text-to-video render. |

<a id="post-api-video-captions-jobs"></a>
### `POST /api/video/captions/jobs`

Transcribe an uploaded/exported clip with Whisper and either return the .srt (result_text) or a captioned mp4 with the subtitles burned in (result_path), depending on `burn_in`. Runs its own Whisper pass (reusing the same isolated whisper venv as /api/tools/whisper) rather than reusing that endpoint's job, since it needs per-segment timestamps and that endpoint only keeps the joined text.

- Handler: [`captions_start_job`](../../../backend/routers/video.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `multipart/form-data`, form)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video` | file | yes |  |  |
| `model` | string | no | `"base"` |  |
| `burn_in` | boolean | no | `true` |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `job_id`, `status`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Whisper env not set up — expected {_WHISPER_PYTHON}. | `captions_start_job` |
| 404 | Whisper wrapper script not found. Check scripts/run_whisper.py | `captions_start_job` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="post-api-video-edit-jobs"></a>
### `POST /api/video/edit/jobs`

Trim and concatenate an ordered list of clips (each either a library job's output or a freshly uploaded file) into one video. `timeline` is a JSON-encoded list of EditClip objects; `source_id` for an "upload" clip is the index into `files` (as a string). `canvas` is one of "vertical"/"square"/"landscape"/"auto" (match the first clip's own aspect). `transitions` is a JSON list of {"type","duration"} objects, one per junction between adjacent clips (length must be len(clips)-1) — every junction defaults to a hard cut unless given a real transition type. `audio_tracks` is a JSON list of EditAudioTrack objects (independently positioned/trimmed/volumed audio layers — background music, a recorded voiceover, etc.), each resolved by `source_id` (index, as a string) into `audio_files`; every track is mixed together and layered starting at its own `offset` (seconds from timeline start). Every clip's own audio is preserved through the concat and mixed in under the tracks unless `mute_clip_audio` is true, in which case it's dropped entirely. Each EditClip's `speed` (default 1.0) rescales that clip's on-timeline duration and pitch-corrects its own audio via ffmpeg's atempo filter; `trim_start`/`trim_end` always stay in source time regardless of speed. `captions_srt`, if non-empty, is a complete .srt document (as produced by the Editor's caption track, already reflecting any manual text/timing edits) burned into the final output as a last ffmpeg pass, after audio mixing.

- Handler: [`edit_start_job`](../../../backend/routers/video.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `multipart/form-data`, form)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timeline` | string | yes |  |  |
| `files` | list of file | no | `[]` |  |
| `canvas` | string | no | `"landscape"` |  |
| `transitions` | string | no | `"[]"` |  |
| `audio_tracks` | string | no | `"[]"` |  |
| `audio_files` | list of file | no | `[]` |  |
| `mute_clip_audio` | boolean | no | `false` |  |
| `captions_srt` | string | no | `""` |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `job_id`, `status`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Audio track index {idx} out of range | `edit_start_job` |
| 400 | Invalid audio_tracks: {e} | `edit_start_job` |
| 400 | Invalid timeline: {e} | `edit_start_job` |
| 400 | Invalid transitions: {e} | `edit_start_job` |
| 400 | Timeline is empty | `edit_start_job` |
| 400 | Unknown source_type {clip.source_type} | `edit_start_job` |
| 400 | Upload index {idx} out of range | `edit_start_job` |
| 400 | transitions must have exactly len(clips)-1 entries | `edit_start_job` |
| 404 | Job {clip.source_id} has no result | `edit_start_job` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-video-library"></a>
### `GET /api/video/library`

Completed video-generation jobs, newest first. Lets the Editor/Captions tabs pick already-generated clips instead of forcing a download-then-reupload round trip.

- Handler: [`video_library`](../../../backend/routers/video.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with `job_id`, `tool`, `created_at`, `result_path`

<a id="get-api-video-music-proxy"></a>
### `GET /api/video/music/proxy`

Stream a Jamendo track's audio through our backend (sidesteps any client-side CORS/mixed-content issues). `url` is allowlisted to jamendo.com hosts so this can't become an open proxy.

- Handler: [`music_proxy`](../../../backend/routers/video.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set; GET/HEAD allowed cross-site (the app's own media and frames)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | query | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: streamed `audio/mpeg` body

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

<a id="get-api-video-music-search"></a>
### `GET /api/video/music/search`

Search Jamendo's Creative Commons catalog for background music. `tags` is a Jamendo genre/mood tag (e.g. "chill", "cinematic", "electronic"); `order` is "popularity_total" or "releasedate".

- Handler: [`music_search`](../../../backend/routers/video.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string | no | `""` |  |
| `tags` | query | string | no | `""` |  |
| `order` | query | string | no | `"popularity_total"` |  |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | `24` |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with `id`, `name`, `artist`, `duration`, `image`, `audio_url`, `license_url`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Couldn't reach Jamendo: {e} | `music_search` |
| 503 | Jamendo isn't configured — get a free client_id at https://devportal.jamendo.com/, set JAMENDO_CLIENT_ID in .env, and restart the backend. | `music_search` |
| e.response.status_code | Jamendo error: {e.response.text[:300]} | `music_search` |
